item: Model-switch list items 1, 2 and 5 (2026-11-25): the marker takes effort, speed and reason besides model; an effort change rides the slider's muted /effort turn, fast mode the footer switch's apply_flag_settings; the continue goes only after every change; the line shows each change and the reason
branch: js/20-markdown.js handoffParse / handoffLine · js/80-gauge.js handoffProblem / startHandoff / handoffAdvance / handoffContinue / handoffEffortDone · js/70-events.js the effortMuted result arm
provenance: The marker texts are hand-made in the protocol's shape (resources/handoff/protocol.md as of 2026-11-25); the assistant frames are un-streamed in the wire's shape, as fixture 119's later steps. The effort turn's result is shaped like the CLI's local-command result the slider's gate already swallows (num_turns 0). window.__bridge is wrapped for the whole fixture, so no /effort turn, model switch or fast-mode request reaches the CLI; the last step restores the bridge, the model chip, the effort slider and fast mode.
